answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Vouching makes fakes traceable: the sponsor's 66-POA bond is cut when its recruit is caught, and the chain climbs, so one bad recruit can burn 5 levels of sponsors. A farm of 820 aliases exposes 820 sponsors at once. The bond is posted before the newcomer answers anything at all. The canyon test is the live device, the gale test is the locked stake, and the ledge test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
